questions.question_text: Which digital graphics format uses mathematical formulas to draw lines and shapes, ensuring no loss of visual quality when scaled for large poster designs?
options: A) JPEG Raster
B) TIFF Format
C) Vector Graphics
D) GIF Animation

questions.question_text: In the traditional printmaking process, what is the specific technical function of a 'brayer' tool?
options: A) Carving intricate details into wood
B) Spreading ink evenly over a relief block
C) Cutting acetate stencils
D) Pressing the damp paper forcefully
questions.answer: B) Spreading ink evenly over a relief block

questions.question_text: What is the primary architectural purpose of building an 'armature' when starting a three-dimensional clay sculpture?
options: A) Providing an internal structural skeleton to support heavy clay
B) Adding a glossy surface finish
C) Measuring the kiln firing temperature
D) Kneading the clay to remove air bubbles
questions.answer: A) Providing an internal structural skeleton to support heavy clay

questions.question_text: In typography composition and digital layout design, the term 'kerning' refers to which spatial adjustment?
options: A) The vertical distance between lines of text
B) The thickness of the paper substrate
C) The horizontal spacing between individual letters or characters
D) The angle of the calligraphy pen nib
questions.answer: C) The horizontal spacing between individual letters or characters

questions.question_text: Which classical art technique involves assembling small, segmented pieces of colored glass, stone, or ceramic to form a coherent surface image?
options: A) Paper Collage
B) Stencil Spraying
C) Drypoint Etching
D) Mosaic Work

sections.section_name: Section B - Theory Short Answer Concepts

questions.question_text: Explain the visual and structural difference between 'serif' and 'sans-serif' typefaces in digital typography and poster design. [25-35 words]
questions.answer: Serif typefaces have small decorative lines or strokes extending from letter edges, offering a classic look. Sans-serif typefaces lack these strokes, providing a clean, modern aesthetic ideal for digital screens.

questions.question_text: Describe the core 'relief' method of printmaking when utilizing a standard linoleum block. [25-35 words]
questions.answer: In relief printmaking, negative spaces are carved away from the linoleum block's flat surface. Ink is then rolled onto the remaining raised areas, which transfers the final image onto paper.

questions.question_text: What is the structural function of adding 'grog' into a fresh sculpting clay body? [25-35 words]
questions.answer: Grog, which is pre-fired and crushed clay, is added to fresh clay bodies to reduce shrinkage, improve structural strength, and prevent cracking or warping during the high-temperature kiln firing process.

questions.question_text: Briefly outline the physical process of creating a basic single-layer stencil for street art or graphic poster design. [25-35 words]
questions.answer: A single-layer stencil involves drawing a high-contrast silhouette on heavy cardstock or acetate. Using a craft knife, the positive shapes are carefully cut out to allow paint to pass through cleanly.

questions.question_text: Define the concept of an 'Art Integrated Portfolio' and state its primary academic purpose in Class 10. [25-35 words]
questions.answer: An Art Integrated Portfolio is a curated collection of a student's creative artworks and cross-curricular projects. It demonstrates progressive skill development, thematic conceptual thinking, and mastery across varied artistic mediums.

sections.section_name: Section C - Practical Composition & Design Layouts

questions.question_text: Detail the practical layout instructions and scoring benchmarks for designing a public environmental awareness poster utilizing calligraphy and flat color blocks. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Evaluation Criteria: The layout must demonstrate a clear typographical hierarchy using structured calligraphy for the primary slogan. Scoring metrics evaluate the balanced distribution of flat acrylic color blocks, strict alignment within a one-inch margin, and the graphic impact of the central environmental motif.

questions.question_text: Develop a practical evaluation rubric for constructing a lifelike three-dimensional human portrait bust using terracotta clay and a wire armature. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Evaluation Criteria: The assessment focuses on the anatomical accuracy of facial proportions, including eye alignment and cranial volume. Points are awarded for the stability of the underlying wire armature, smooth surface modeling techniques, and successful hollowing out of the base to prevent firing cracks.

questions.question_text: Outline the practical studio workflow required for cutting and registering a two-color linocut print edition on standard cartridge paper. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Workflow Criteria: Students must carve two separate linoleum blocks of identical dimensions. Registration marks must be perfectly aligned on the printing press bed. Scoring evaluates the precise overlap of the lighter base color and the darker contour ink without shifting or smudging the final edition.

sections.section_name: Section D - Applied Art Portfolios & Digital Synthesis

questions.question_text: Analyze the digital workflow required for transforming a traditional hand-drawn calligraphy quote into a scalable vector graphic for a commercial poster design. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The workflow begins by scanning the original inked calligraphy at a high resolution. The image is imported into vector software where the image trace function converts raster pixels into mathematical vector paths. Designers then refine bezier curves, adjust anchor points for smoothness, and apply CMYK color swatches for print-ready scalable poster layouts.

questions.question_text: Propose a curation strategy for compiling an 'Art Integrated Project Portfolio' that effectively combines physical mask-making crafts with digital presentation formats. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The curation strategy requires photographing the three-dimensional physical masks from multiple angles with studio lighting to capture surface textures. These images are imported into desktop publishing software, arranged on digital grid layouts, and paired with analytical typography detailing the cultural history of the masks, creating a cohesive, professional PDF portfolio presentation.
